finding: Missing PG prerequisite -> explicit 0/0 skip -> exit0
suggested_fix: Fail required run with nonzero status; optional mode must expose NOT-RUN and never satisfy release evidence

finding: Missing fixture -> bare return -> wrapper increments PASS with zero assertions
suggested_fix: Required fixture must exist; otherwise fail or propagate a separately counted skip; add per-case count guards

finding: Empty requirements registry can return green with no reviewed items
suggested_fix: Require nonempty expected requirement IDs and independent current-SHA evidence for each item

finding: Pattern-wide never-expiring allowlist also suppresses a new unapproved file
suggested_fix: Bind exceptions to file/line or content hash, owner/reason/expiry and replacement test

finding: Cleanup oracle is assert(true), not observable cleanup
suggested_fix: Assert all created users/enrollments/classes removed; negative mutation should fail

finding: Map-backed mock isPostgres=true cannot prove PostgreSQL/container restart durability
suggested_fix: Keep unit/fixture label; require real PG + process kill/restart evidence before production claim

finding: Child exit0 is promoted to unconditional full production-grade proof
suggested_fix: Aggregate evidence levels/prerequisites/actual checks; do not upgrade mocked children

finding: Discovered count does not equal execution: only three entrypoints invoked
suggested_fix: Persist per-suite execution manifest; compare discovered runnable tests minus governed exclusions

finding: Production truth gate conditional on secret/environment; absent prerequisite skips it
suggested_fix: Required release path must report NOT VERIFIED and fail; optional jobs must not satisfy required runtime proof

finding: 486 unwired top-level JS exceeds declared budget485; budget is not full coverage
suggested_fix: Build graph-aware coverage ledger; wire required suites, do not merely raise budget

finding: Foreign-manager negative check omitted when fixture absent
suggested_fix: Seed a second manager and require expected negative assertion count; missing fixture must fail
